reason: TriggerMode::ChangesController carries a side (ControlChangeSide: Loses | Gains) and serializes as {"ChangesController":{"side":...}} in GameState trigger and delayed-trigger definitions and card data; a previous full-game or P2P peer cannot decode the struct-variant form.
